node.statement: Multiplication is continuous bilinear and dagger is continuous conjugate-linear, hence both are C^1 as real maps. The inverse component u_delta:S_delta->calU is C^1 by lem-stage1-polar-retraction; composing with the globally S_delta-valued maps from the preceding step proves that mu and sigma are C^1 and calU-valued on their asserted domains.
